fato_historico: 2019: Typhoon Hagibis makes landfall in Japan, killing 10 and forcing the evacuation of one million people.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle reset for your spirit. Just as nature must occasionally withstand the power of the great winds to find stillness, consider how your own resilience shapes your path. It is a good time to release old tensions and allow your intuition to flow freely toward new, hopeful horizons that sparkle with potential.
frase_do_dia: Even the strongest winds clear the way for brighter days ahead.
significado_numero: A powerful portal representing spiritual intuition and inner awakening.
conselho: Trust your inner wisdom and stay grounded amidst the swirling changes.
